data.one_liner: Provides responsive helpers for width, height, font size and unit conversions in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It wraps the app to expose extension methods like .w, .h, .sp, .dp and absolute units. These calculate values as percentages of screen size or physical units, enabling responsive UI design.
use_when: You need quick, percentage‑based sizing without custom layout code.
You want to support multiple screen types (mobile, tablet, desktop) with a single API.
You prefer extension methods over manual MediaQuery calculations.
avoid_when: You need fine‑grained control over layout beyond simple percentages.
You are building a highly custom widget tree that requires manual constraints.
strengths: Supports many units (cm, mm, inches, etc.)
Handles orientation and screen type automatically
weaknesses: Relies on extension methods, which may not auto‑import in IDEs
No built‑in theming or advanced layout widgets
May add runtime overhead for every call
data.setup_notes: Add dependency and wrap MaterialApp with ResponsiveSizer widget.
